nodes.label: Assistant UI Native Composition Decision
nodes.rationale: Use assistant-ui native present with an application-owned TravelPlan and quote service; keep json-render as an alternative renderer.

nodes.label: Direct Filter Transfer Gap
nodes.rationale: Missing transfer data defaults to zero, so the current direct-only control does not prove transfer support.

nodes.label: Undefined Fare Unit and Monetary Total
nodes.norm_label: undefined fare unit and monetary total
nodes.rationale: The backend total is a result count and current fare unit, fees, and passenger basis are undefined.

nodes.label: Recommended assistant-ui Travel Planner Architecture
nodes.rationale: Use one conversation and component-tree engine, stable application actions, backend-loaded plan context, and authoritative quotes.

nodes.label: Single Route Search Limitation
nodes.rationale: The current application represents one outbound leg and optional reversed return, not a multi-city mixed-mode itinerary.

nodes.label: Revision and Request Stale Response Protection
nodes.norm_label: revision and request stale response protection
nodes.rationale: Async results may update the active plan only when plan, query revision, and request ID still match.

nodes.label: Active Plan and Historical Conversation State
nodes.norm_label: active plan and historical conversation state
nodes.rationale: Keep one mutable active plan and append-only historical artifacts; old cards require explicit restore or fork.

nodes.label: Incremental TypeScript Boundary Migration
nodes.rationale: Migrate domain, transport, tool, catalog, action, and persistence boundaries first without requiring a full rewrite.

nodes.label: Browser Captures
nodes.rationale: The inspected captures were not committed because the browser session did not provide a persistent local export path.

nodes.label: Generated SQLite Database
nodes.rationale: The database remains outside Git because it is generated data.

nodes.label: Performance Timings
nodes.rationale: The measured timings are machine-specific observations rather than service level guarantees.

nodes.label: UI Pagination State
nodes.rationale: The Next button was expected to be disabled because the accepted UI routes returned fewer results than the default page size.

nodes.label: Branch Naming Convention
nodes.rationale: Slash-separated lowercase hyphenated names create readable branch namespaces.

nodes.label: dev Branch
nodes.rationale: Serves as the integration branch for ongoing work.

nodes.label: main Branch
nodes.rationale: Contains stable, releasable code.

nodes.label: Generated Inventory Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: The project identifies schedules and fares as generated examples so users do not mistake the demo for live or bookable inventory.

nodes.label: Complete Route Day Coverage
nodes.rationale: Every directional route receives service on every date so searches remain populated throughout the timetable range.
